'''Torchy''' was a [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] [[ALT-25]] [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] owned by [[Corso Riggs]]. It was his first blaster given to him during his time in the [[Peace Brigade (Cold War)|Peace Brigade]]. During a mission on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], it was stolen from him by a scoundrel, [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]]. who was still in possession of this weapon when Corso and his ally, known as [[Voidhound|Ace]], were ambushed by Skavak after finding the lost treasure of the pirate, [[Nok Drayen]]. It is not known whether it was Corso or [[Bowdaar]] who assisted "Ace" in the fight against Skavak, but it is known that Torchy was looted from the corpse of Skavak. Back aboard Ace's [[XS stock light freighter/Legends|XS stock light freighter]], Corso asked the smuggler about the weapon, though it is unknown whether the Smuggler returned the weapon to its rightful owner or kept it for themselves.<ref name="Torchy" />
